{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Ugnaughts' Progress''''' was an award-winning [[holodocumentary]] presented by [[Ars Fivvle]] of ''[[Action Tidings]]'' fame. It told the story of how the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] helped built [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and prospered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], drawing much from over fifty [[Standard year|years]] worth of rare footage from ''Action Tidings'' broadcasts. It was so popular that it was picked up for [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] distribution.<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040930bespinmain|text=Bespin: Action Tidings|int=Bespin: Action Tidings}}</ref>
